metadata.name: GetLoyaltyRuleDetails
metadata.description:
This API is used to Get Details of  Loyalty Rule via RuleID.
Note: Rule ID can be Retreived using the 'SearchLoyaltyRuleDetails' API.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: RuleID
request_fields.description: ID of Loyalty Rule. Valid Values: 0-9(Value provided by Corecard) Format: XXXX Example:1234

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: LoyaltyRule
children.description: LoyaltyRule

children.name: RuleID
children.description: ID of Loyalty Rule. Valid Values: 0-9(Value provided by Corecard) Format: XXXX Example:1234

children.name: RuleName
children.description: Name of the Loyalty Rule. Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example:Base Rule Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RuleType
children.description: Flag to decide the type of Loyalty Rule Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section 5.39 Loyalty: Rule Type 0: Base 1:Promotional 2:Advance Promotional 3:Exclusion Format:X Example:1

children.name: RuleTypeDesc
children.description: Displays the Description of the Rule Type Valid Values: Base, Promotional, Advance Promotional and Exclusion Example: Advance Promotional Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RuleDescription
children.description: Description of the Loyalty Rule Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 2% Reward on All Purchases Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RuleDetailDescription
children.description: Displays the Detail Description of the Rule. Valid Values: a-z Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RuleApplication
children.description: Type of transaction on which the Loyalty rule should trigger for the Account. Valid Values:Refer Appendix Section 5.40 Loyalty: Rule Application. Format:X Example:5

children.name: RuleApplicationDesc
children.description: Displays the Description of the Type of Transaction on which the Loyalty rule should trigger for the Account. Valid Values: a-z Example: Purchase Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RuleSetUpOn
children.description: Addtional criteria on which Loyalty rule should trigger for the Account. Valid Values:Refer Appendix Section 5.41 Loyalty: Rule Setup On Format:X Example:5

children.name: RuleSetUpOnDesc
children.description: Description of the Addtional criteria on which Loyalty rule should trigger for the Account. Valid Values: a-z Example: None Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RuleStatus
children.description: Status of Loyalty Rule. Valid Values: 0: Active 1: Inactive Format: X Example: 1

children.name: RuleStatusDesc
children.description: Status of Loyalty Rule. Valid Values: Active or  Inactive Example: Active Allowable Values: 20

children.name: RuleCalculationMethod
children.description: Indicates method used to calculate the loyalty transaction. Valid Values: '0' = None '1' = Use Amount '2' = Use Percent '3' = Use Tiers Example: 2

children.name: CalculationBase
children.description: Indicates the Calulation Base used for Calculations. Valid Values: '1' = Txn Amount '2' = Base Reward '3' = Promo Reward '4' = Total Reward Example: 2

children.name: CalculationAmountPoints
children.description: The fixed number of points that is earned each time the corresponding transaction is posted against a loyalty participating amount. This field is only valid if the Calculation Method field is set to Use Amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 100

children.name: CalculationPercent
children.description: The percent of the loyalty transaction. This field is only valid if the Calculation Method field is set to Use Percent.

children.name: RoundingMethod
children.description: Defines how fractional transaction amounts are rounded into the point amount. Valid Values: '0' - None '1' - Round up to next rounding unit '2' - Round down to next rounding unit '3' - Round up or down to next rounding unit Example: 0

children.name: RoundingUnit
children.description: When Rounding Method is set a value other than None, this field is used to indicate the number of decimal places that is acknowledged for the points. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 2

children.name: PurchaseHistoryFound
children.description: In case 'Yes' is selected then, system looks back the transaction history for X months of the merchant from where return is received and further claw back logic would be evaluated to calculate the loyalty points. All other group boxes would be disabled as we do not want user to setup any value as in this condition hardcoded logic would be applied. In case 'No is selected then, the system looks back for the transaction history for X months from the merchant where transaction is received and assess the loyalty points based on percentage set under the calculation method parameters on the same panel.It means that Calculation Method parameters should be enabled where the fixed percentage value can be defined as per requirement. Valid Values: 1 = Yes and 0 = No Example: 1

children.name: XMonths
children.description: Displays the Number of Months for Purchase History Found. If Displayed 1 means that system would need to look back at the history from merchant for the past one month and 2 means two months and so on. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 6 Condition: Will be displayed/Populated only if Purchase History Found is Yes

children.name: TotalSpendThresholdAmount
children.description: Indicates the Maximum Total Transactions Amount on which this Loyalty Rule must be applicable. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 100.00

children.name: TotalPercentCap
children.description: Indicates that upto what Percent the Rewards can be redeemed Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 10.00

children.name: RecurringReward
children.description: This tag indicates either the rule is a recurring reward or not. Valid Values: 1 = Yes, 0 = No Example: 1

children.name: RecurringRewardApplicableAfter
children.description: This tag shows the applicable duration after a particular time period. Valid Values: 4: Month 6: Billing Period Example: 6

children.name: RecurringRewardApplicableFrom
children.description: This tag indicates the instance from which Reward will be Applicable. Valid Values: 0: None 1: Card Provisioning 2: Account Open Date 3: From First Purchase Date Example: 3

children.name: ThresholdSpendCTD
children.description: Indidates Maximum spend during 1 cycle Period in which Rewards will be Earned. Example: 400.00

children.name: MaxLoyaltyAmountEarningLimit
children.description: Indicates the Maximum Amount that can be Earned by the Card/Account Holder under this Loyalty Rule Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 100.00

children.name: TransactionSizeThresholdAmount
children.description: Indicates the Minimum Transaction Amount the Card/Account Holder needs to do for qualifying for this Loyalty Rule Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 100.00

children.name: TransactionCountThreshold
children.description: Indicates the Maximum number of Purchase Transactions till which this Loyalty Rule will be applicable Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 10

children.name: RewardNextToXTransactions
children.description: This field indicates the number of transactions i.e. X after which reward would start being applicable on incoming transactions. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 10

children.name: RewardApplicableFrom
children.description: This tag shows the applicable date from a particular time period. Valid Values: 0: None 1: Card Provisioning 2: Account Open Date 3: From First Purchase Date 4: Wallet Enrollment and Spend 5: Auto Pay Enrollment Date Example: 3

children.name: RewardApplicableTo
children.description: This tag shows the applicable date to a particular time period. Valid Values: 1: Hour 2: Day 3: Week 4: Month 5: Year 6: Billing Period Example: 3

children.name: ApplicableToXPeriod
children.description: This tag indicates the number of counts of the value set in 'RewardApplicableto'. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:10

children.name: TransactiontocheckforThreshold
children.description: This Tag indicates what  incoming transaction is required to be checked against the threshold defined in Reward Next To X Transactions. The values are: Authorization – If selected as authorization, it means if an incoming authorization comes it would participate in counting of transactions against the threshold value.It won’t matter whether the incoming authorization request is cleared or not. Clearing – If selected then unless the incoming transaction gets cleared and posted in the CC system, it won’t be counted against the threshold value. Valid Values: 1 - Authorization and 2 - Clearing Format: X Example:1

children.name: MinimumCalculation
children.description: Indicates If Minimum amount to be considered for Reward Calculation or Not. Valid Values: 1 = Yes or 0 = No Format:X Example: 1 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: OneTimeReward
children.description: Indicates if the loyalty Rule is applicable only once or not. Valid Values: 1 = Yes or 0 = No Format:X Example: 1

children.name: CalculatedRewardsOnOldTransactionsCount
children.description: Indicates if Rewards is Calculated on Transactions Count that occurred while reaching the Count Threshold. Valid Values: 1 = Yes or 0 = No Example:1

children.name: CalculatedRewardsOnOldTransactionsSpend
children.description: Indicates if Rewards is Calculated on Total  Transactions Amount that occurred while Reaching the Amount Threshold Valid Values: 1 = Yes or 0 = No Example:1

children.name: NumberofConsecutiveGoodPayments
children.description: Indicates after what number of Good Payments, Reward will be Applicable. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 6 Condition: only Valid if Rule Setup is on Good Payments.

children.name: ChecktopSpending
children.description: Indicates on how many of Top Spendings with a particular MCC reward is applicable. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 6

children.name: RuleTypeInAlert
children.description: Indicates what Rule Type in Alert Notification will be sent. Valid Values: 0 = Exlcusion 1 = Base 2 = Bonus 3 = Activation Example: 3

children.name: RuleReQualification
children.description: Indicates if the Rule is Eligible for Re-qualification or Not. Valid Values: 1 = Yes or 0 = No Format:X Example: 1

children.name: OperatorConditon
children.description: This field indicates the calculation sign so while setting up an advance loyalty rule paramete. this field would define whether the number of transactions to consider for loyalty reward should be equal to or less than or greater than the specified number. Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AmountOrCount
children.description: This tag displays the Amount or Count depending on the Paraneter name Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1000 or 5 Condition: Depends on the Parameter

children.name: LogicalOperator
children.description: This field decides whether the rule will run independently, or more additional rules or logic is required to be run. Valid Values: AND =  If displays AND then the Rule will check conditions of following rows also, OR = If Displays OR then the Rule will check if condition satisfies of any One row END = If Displays END, then rule will not check any row beyond this Row Example: AND Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AddtionalLogicalOperator
children.description: This field has an additional logical operator which would check another row for rule qualification. Valid Values: AND and OR Example: AND Allowable Values: 10
